therapeutic_summary: Haemolytic anaemia is a form of anaemia due to haemolysis — the abnormal breakdown of red blood cells (RBC) either in the blood vessels (intravascular haemolysis) or elsewhere in the body (extravascular). Acquired haemolytic anaemia may be caused by immune-mediated causes, drugs, infections, burns, lead poisoning, or mechanical causes such as prosthetic heart valves. Symptoms include fatigue, shortness of breath, jaundice, and increased risk of gallstones and pulmonary hypertension. Treatment depends on cause and nature of breakdown.

mandatory_criteria.description: Member is registered on the chronic medicine programme or registration is initiated by an authorised HCP or broker
mandatory_criteria.failure_message: Member is not registered on the chronic medicine programme. Registration must occur before authorisation can be issued.

mandatory_criteria.description: Diagnosis confirmed with an applicable ICD-10 code from the protocol list (D59.0–D59.9)
mandatory_criteria.failure_message: The submitted ICD-10 code does not match any applicable code under DTP-113S (Acquired Haemolytic Anaemia). Codes D59.0–D59.9 are applicable.

mandatory_criteria.description: Confirmation of chronic medicine authorisation received by member
mandatory_criteria.failure_message: Chronic medicine authorisation confirmation has not been issued. Member cannot access benefits until confirmation is received.

mandatory_criteria.description: Treating practitioner is a General Practitioner or Physician/Paediatrician with valid HPCSA registration
mandatory_criteria.failure_message: Treating practitioner discipline is not aligned to the approved disciplines for DTP-113S. A GP, physician, paediatrician, or haematologist is required.

conditional_criteria.description: Clinical motivation submitted manually — triggers Medical Advisor review for non-standard care plan requests
Haemolytic anaemia caused by immune-mediated or drug-related factors requiring specialist haematologist review
Member has comorbid autoimmune condition (SLE, CLL) requiring multidisciplinary review

rejection_criteria.description: ICD-10 code submitted is outside the applicable DTP-113S code range entirely
rejection_criteria.failure_message: Rejected: Submitted diagnosis code is not applicable under DTP-113S. Please resubmit with the correct ICD-10 code or an appropriate protocol.

rejection_criteria.description: Member has no valid scheme membership at date of request
rejection_criteria.failure_message: Rejected: Member does not have an active scheme membership. Authorisation cannot be issued without valid membership.

rejection_criteria.description: Requested care items fall outside the approved basket of care for DTP-113S
rejection_criteria.failure_message: Rejected: Requested care items are not included in the approved basket of care for DTP-113S. A clinical motivation must be submitted separately.
